rows.text:
Dearest Bequea,
Stories about you are spreading all over the streets... We all feel so sorry for you.
Miss Bequea, you have to pull yourself together and find your happiness again.
When you're able to come to Duomension City to meet us in person, I'll bring a bouquet to congratulate you on your recovery!

To the miraculous survivor, Miss Bequea:
Miss Bequea, I sincerely hope that you, the idol who moved all of Planarcadia, can make a swift recovery.
Our society has been panicked by the Herald of Death for far too long, but you, who bravely overcame suffering to return to the Elation, will become the new symbol of hope!
Let's declare to the Herald of Death on behalf of all Planarcadia:
Happiness will not be defeated by suffering!
